'''June 2000 Phoenix tournament (25 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in AZ Gamer, Arizona on 25 June 2000. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d945">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ it-has-a-cute-butt], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 June 2000
* '''Site:''' AZ Gamer, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
